C0623.title: Illegal! Man Arrested for Cashing Out Consumer Vouchers via Fake Transactions, Illegally Profiting Over 80,000 Yuan
C0623.summary: From March 16 to 17, 2023, Li, a restaurant operator in Shiyan, Hubei, helped others cash out 'Huigou Hubei' consumer vouchers through fake purchases. Within two days, the transaction volume reached over 390,000 yuan, and Li illegally profited more than 80,000 yuan. Li was arrested by police on suspicion of fraud.
